title: Christ In You, The Hope of Glory
speaker: Pastor Billy Philips
summary: Week three detonates the word the false teachers loved most: mystery. Paul empties it of every price tag. The secret is out, and it has a name. Christ in you, the hope of glory. No inner ring, no room down the hall, no spiritual elite. Only Christ, fully yours, making ordinary people whole.
subtitle: The treasure is a Person, and He lives in you.
